name: Tramplesaurus Rex
notes: Interim 100-card mono-green Commander deck for the Foundations Tramplesaurus Rex precon (official list unreleased; Ruling M3-P). Commanded by Ghalta, Primal Hunger (12/12 trample). KNOWN ENGINE LIMITATION, measured not assumed: the build does not read a cost-reduction static the card carries on itself — rules/statics.go's activeStatics only collects S: lines from battlefield permanents, and parseAmount on an Amount$ X SVar defaults to 1 — so Ghalta costs a flat 12 in every game under this engine; see the m38 report. The deck is therefore built as honest big-green that CAN reach twelve mana: 37 lands (31 Forest plus a land-search utility suite), seven mana rocks (Sol Ring through Prismatic Lens), eleven land-ramp pieces (Rampant Growth through Skyshroud Claim, plus Nature's Lore, Three Visits, Springbloom Druid and Khalni Heart Expedition), a full dork battery (Llanowar Elves family plus Priest of Titania, Elvish Archdruid, Sakura-Tribe Elder, Wood Elves, Whisperer of the Wilds), and high-power beaters (Steel Leaf Champion, Leatherback Baloth, Colossal Dreadmaw, Ancient Brontodon, Pelakka Wurm) so it pressures and survives while the mana comes together; Craterhoof Behemoth and Overrun finish, and Garruk's Uprising / World Shaper turn the big bodies and a removal-happy opponent into cards and lands. Fix round 1 added the second Search-a-Forest two-drop pair (Nature's Lore, Three Visits), Springbloom Druid and Khalni Heart Expedition (removal-proof ramp the creature-removal decks cannot kill), Prismatic Lens, Whisperer of the Wilds, and the two draw/recursion engines, replacing the weakest combat tricks and vanilla bodies (Giant Growth, Titanic Growth, Might of the Masses, Grizzly Bears, Nessian Courser, Stingerfling Spider), Hooting Mandrills and the slow Hedron Archive — re-measured under m34 free-for-all combat, where one seeded draw around a flat-12 mana requirement is a coin flip. Colour identity is exactly green: every non-Forest land and artifact is colourless-identity, and no card carries a coloured symbol outside green.
